kind: Structural ports from official production JavaScript; not original TSX or full-site parity

shell-and-tabs.source: app-shell-D1-nY-va.js Gbt/Kbt/R6/Yst/Pst; AgentDetailPanel-B3FrpUPj.js; ChatPanel default sortable tabs
shell-and-tabs.adaptation: Single workspace renders a static native-typography label without an unsupported organization selector. Loom supplies notification entries and revisioned tab ordering; no official cloud collector. Role-specific tab content is retained.
shell-and-tabs.preserved: Search anchor, draft navigation, notification popup/focus, unknown writes, tab drag/order and instance lifecycle

chat-composer-drawer-task-chrome.source: app-shell-D1-nY-va.js MessageInput toolbar/ComposerToolbarLabel, yxt/bxt drawer composition, TasksPanel header/picker/view controls
chat-composer-drawer-task-chrome.adaptation: Existing Loom submit/task/file interfaces retained. Single + file tool and compact mobile reading layout remain owner-approved local features. Native controls own geometry and typography; native line height is used to center compact placeholder. Only existing channel filter is exposed; creator/assignee filters and task row refresh are still pending. All close guards retained.

feed-and-unread.source: v1.21.22 ThreadsInbox-CbSKTW4g.js Ie/Le/Re and InboxRow; app-shell-D1-nY-va.js TaskCard, RailTabButton and MessageItem highlight
feed-and-unread.adaptation: Loom activity rows and durable mark actions retained. Existing sidebar activity summary request also feeds desktop navigation, without extra polling or independent counts. Touch Done action remains visible because native activity context menus are not yet connected. Official list-layout/grouping options are pending.

task-filters.source: v1.21.22 app-shell-D1-nY-va.js ZSt task toolbar, XSt identity picker and n8/rlt/tlt SelectionPopover composition
task-filters.adaptation: Official multi-select triggers, selected counts, sentinel order, search, native Popover focus/dismissal and clear-all. Loom principal IDs and authenticated search directory replace upstream users/agents stores; URL uses taskRoom/taskCreator/taskAssignee for existing routing compatibility. Kernel task.global.list owns filtering/pagination (including assignee OR unassigned), not filtering the currently loaded page. Directory failure disables identity choices and offers retry. No backend changes.

activity-actions.source: v1.21.22 ThreadsInbox-CbSKTW4g.js je menu + app-shell t$/R4e MenuItem and xA ContextMenuPopup recipe
activity-actions.adaptation: Channel/DM read, unread and done use exact captured Loom frontiers. Threads retain Done only: current activity projection lacks isFollowing, so upstream conditional read/follow controls are omitted. Canonical unknown-result handling refreshes without resending. Native ContextMenuPopup/DismissBackdrop/placement helper retained; placement measures effective native width (min-w-60 overrides upstream page width:184) to avoid edge clipping. Keyboard open/arrow/Escape and focus return added around the same native popup. Touch Done remains reachable; physical iOS/Android long-press not verified.

settings-composition.source: v1.21.22 app-shell-D1-nY-va.js hct settings sidebar, ypt settings detail shell, gpt appearance, e8 section header and $U/wXe/TXe section label
settings-composition.adaptation: Native group label/item content/title composition, icon-free detail header, inset panel and mobile/desktop body padding; native appearance Card typography and one divided preference group. Existing Loom appearance stores, runtime draft persistence, read/write protection, mobile navigation and unsupported-setting omissions retained. Section label uppercase prop retained for caller compatibility but native source casing wins. No backend changes.

computers.source: v1.21.22 app-shell-D1-nY-va.js $yt desktop row, zCt/RCt mobile panel, wZ status dot; MachineDetailPanel-C2oaC119.js header/profile/description/info; KeyValueRow-TXegGs9j.js
computers.adaptation: Structural port, not byte-exact TSX. Native list/detail/card/header and neutral icon tone; desktop defaults to local host, mobile retains list/back. Existing authenticated host.runtime.list read owner and freshness rules. Native inline name/description editors bind computer.profile.update with captured revision and WriteIntentSlot exact unknown replay; drafts protected. Detected CLI soft badges use actual available/version/path facts, not login or online inference. Remote add, upgrades, deletion and disk/session sections omitted. No backend changes.

chat-settings-drawer.source: v1.21.22 app-shell-D1-nY-va.js Lxt / Rxt settings Drawer, NW neutral header tone; MachineDetailPanel-C2oaC119.js inline name/description and detected runtimes; native ChannelMemberList
chat-settings-drawer.adaptation: Native right DrawerContent dimensions/header/title/description/scroll body replaces old action sheet; member rows move inside it, member/add/private/profile callbacks close drawer first. Existing Loom task/memory/execution policies retained as local content; archived channels remain member-readable with control actions omitted. Metadata, activity mute and archive/restore now integrated in channel-settings-form; upstream-only visibility/guest/joint/share/delete policies remain excluded. Header search reuses TopBarSearch event handler, composer outer separator removed. No backend changes.

channel-settings-form.source: v1.21.22 app-shell-D1-nY-va.js Rxt metadata form/footer, fU field semantics, dk FormSection, B7 action rows
channel-settings-form.adaptation: Native name/description form, required/optional field labels, rows=2 description, divided groups, large footer controls and small outline actions. Existing room.update uses captured sync basis and preserves visibility without sending task/steer policy. Unknown writes use exact WriteIntentSlot replay; conflicts retain draft and require reread. Drawer dirty/route protection and close confirmation. Notification is precisely Loom mutedActivity, not an invented push setting; same sidebar.get/patch versioned contract and refresh hint. Archive/restore reuses ManagementClient and confirmation; #all rename/archive unavailable. No backend changes or new stores.

composer-suggestions.source: v1.21.22 app-shell-D1-nY-va.js g0 autocomplete hook, v0 option row, X0/Z0 candidate body/avatar, Q0 suggestion groups and task/send toolbar
composer-suggestions.adaptation: Structural style port: native Badge sizing, neutral 19px computer/app icons, opacity-only muted avatars, explicit Separator/group padding, accessory gap. Audited retained autocomplete/IME/keyboard/task/send composition; no new input state machine. # candidate read bound to authorized existing Loom directory via context; deduplicated active/archived channels only, excludes private boxes/Side/direct rooms. Native ranked search and insertion retained; no upstream store hydration. Unified + file/reference dialog and touch Enter rule remain explicit owner-approved Loom adaptations. No provider/backend/prompt changes.

page-polish.source: v1.21.22 app-shell Rxt/Lxt and sSt TaskCard; AgentDetailPanel ConversationPanelTabs composition; ThreadsInbox Q/Ie; MachineDetailPanel detectedRuntimes/agentsOnComputer
page-polish.adaptation: Flat settings members and icon private action; remove owner-rejected corner X while retaining footer/Escape and draft guard. Remove conflicting Role TabsList max-width class, retaining current production ConversationPanelTabs. Durable global activity counts and bounded all-unread frontier capture with no write retries. Native context icon geometry and conditional metadata spacing. Aggregate Kernel execution state per Role; host runtime offer bindings intersect Role instances, not inferred process liveness. Native task count wording, no loaded/total fraction. Existing TaskCard structural port verified against sSt; no speculative redesign.
limits: Role badge means observed execution, not resident CLI process existence.
Computer list is local-host offer-bound instances; remote Computers remain frozen.
All-read caps capture at 100 pages and aborts without writes on repeated cursors; partial writes on failure are disclosed and refreshed.
TaskCard matches locked v1.21.22; no claim of equality to a later unexamined web release.
No real paid CLI or physical mobile-device acceptance.
